# Data handling policy

Dated 2026-08-21.

## Export

**No bulk data export capability will be built or enabled before Q1 2027.**
The residency review that would license it is not scheduled to conclude until
December 2026, and building the capability ahead of that review is prohibited.
Per-record export through support remains the only sanctioned path.

## Retention

Audit logs are retained for 90 days. Any change to that figure requires a
signed amendment to this policy.
